title: 第602章 狐狸头骨第601章 青牛妖
slug: 修仙所有人都以为她背景很强
lines: “我要巡视你的草原。”巫未央态度强势发令。
青山对王族同样怀揣着敬畏，更何况巫未央说一不二的模样，它也不敢反抗，便同意了，但提出要给巫未央带路，显然还留着一分怀疑，怕这位王族使者伤害青牛妖族。
它们的防备心倒是比火鹿妖强上一点。
巫未央眸光斜去，火桠已经被妖墟里的东西吸引了，正按捺不住地左右扭头。
青山：“使者，我们什么时候去巡视草原？”
巫未央：“现在。”
她不仅想要弄清楚妖族领域血月组织的情况，还在担心其他人，所以心里偶尔会有一股急切。
然而令巫未央失望的是，在属于青牛妖族领地的平原上巡视数天，还是没找到一个人影。
难不成只有她一个人偏离了方向，落在了西陆？
巫未央不得不作此猜测。
将平原上每一个犄角旮旯都探查过后，巫未央死心地随青山回了青牛妖族的高栏领地。
“使者，你回来了！”火桠蹦蹦跳跳跑来，“妖墟正好快结束了，你来看看吗？”
巫未央收拾了一下心情，微微颔首。
妖墟与人族的坊市相似，只不过摊主和来往的身影千奇百怪。
西陆鹿妖和青牛妖称霸，剩下的妖族，可见修为低下，人形显露出很多原形特征，甚至有不少妖族，是不通妖族语言的。
只是妖族之间好像并没有因为不同种族，语言不同而沟通障碍。
这可苦了巫未央。
面对那些听不懂的各族妖语，她不能表现得不懂，只能通过火桠的反应来推测。
最重要的是，她没有妖族的交易货币，石晶。
巫未央见过火桠手中的石晶，带有棱角的透明晶块，几乎都是一掌可握的大小，内里蕴含了浓郁的妖气，某种意义上，石晶就是灵石的另一种形态。
但或许是妖气暴虐，不像灵气那般温和，所以石晶便不能像灵石那样圆滑温润，反而多含尖锐的棱角。
巫未央目光可惜地掠过一众摊子上充满妖异气息的货物。
她瞧见了一些看起来可以用于炼器的灵矿，心底很想研究研究。
奈何兜里满满，却好像没什么可以拿出来的。
正当巫未央打算狠心离开时，一样东西进入了她的视野。
一块彩绘的狐狸头骨。
她看到头骨的一瞬间，下意识摸了摸脸。
无他，这块狐狸头骨通体雪白，眼睛轮廓周围的一缕缕彩绘密集又复杂，却正好是千灵幻面内里器纹脉络的走向。
不会错的，巫未央为了修复千灵幻面，研究了它的器纹脉络不知道几百上千次。
她快步走到那个摊子前，将狐狸头骨拿起，反复观察。
“使者，这是狐狸的头骨。”火桠凑过来看了一眼，随即瞥向摊主，“喂，你一只小麻雀怎么会有狐狸的头骨。”
在妖族领域，狐狸可是和王族深绑的。
火桠害怕这块狐狸头骨会让巫未央感到愤怒，继而迁怒西陆。
小麻雀被两人吓了一跳，叽叽喳喳几声后，火桠明显放松了一些，“使者，你看在它只是捡的份上，就饶过它吧。”
“也不知道它一个小麻雀怎么能飞到中心大陆去的。”
content_en:
"I want to inspect your grassland." Wu Weiyang gave the order with a strong attitude.
Qingshan was also in awe of the royal family, not to mention Wu Weiyang's words. It did not dare to resist, so it agreed, but offered to lead the way for Wu Weiyang. It was obviously still a bit suspicious, fearing that this royal envoy would harm the Qingniu Monster Clan.
Their defensiveness is a bit stronger than that of the Fire Deer Demon.
Wu Weiyang glanced sideways, Huo Ya had been attracted by the things in the demon ruins, and was turning his head left and right uncontrollably.
Qingshan: "Messenger, when are we going to inspect the grassland?"
Wu Weiyang: "Now."
Not only did she want to find out the situation of the Blood Moon Organization in the Demon Clan Domain, but she was also worried about other people, so she occasionally felt anxious in her heart.
However, Wu Weiyang was disappointed that after patrolling the plains belonging to the territory of the Green Bull Demon Clan for several days, he still could not find a single figure.
Could it be that she was the only one who deviated from the direction and landed in the Western Continent?
Wu Weiyang had no choice but to make this guess.
After exploring every nook and cranny on the plain, Wu Weiyang followed Qingshan back to the Gaolan territory of the Qingniu Monster Clan.
"Messenger, you're back!" Huo Ya came jumping up and down, "The Demon Fairy is about to end, will you come and take a look?"
Wu Weiyang calmed down and nodded slightly.
The monster market is similar to the human market, except that the stall owners and the figures coming and going are all kinds of strange.
The deer demon and the green bull demon dominate the Western Continent. It can be seen that the remaining demon tribes have low cultivation levels, and their human forms show many original characteristics. There are even many demon tribes who do not understand the demon tribe's language.
It's just that there doesn't seem to be any communication barriers between the demon clans due to different races and different languages.
This is very painful for Wu Weiyang.
Faced with the demonic language of various tribes that she didn't understand, she couldn't show her ignorance and could only deduce it through Huo Ya's reaction.
The most important thing is that she doesn't have the demon clan's trading currency, stone crystals.
Wu Weiyang had seen the stone crystals in Huo Ya's hands. They were transparent crystal blocks with edges and corners, almost the size of a palm. They contained rich demonic energy. In a sense, stone crystals were another form of spiritual stones.
But maybe the demonic energy is violent and not as gentle as the spiritual energy, so the stone crystal cannot be as smooth and gentle as the spiritual stone, but instead contains sharp edges and corners.
Wu Weiyang's eyes glanced regretfully at the strange-looking goods on the stalls.
She saw some spiritual mines that looked like they could be used to refine weapons, and she really wanted to study them.
However, my pocket is full, but there seems to be nothing to take out.
Just when Wu Weiyang was about to leave cruelly, something came into her sight.
A painted fox skull.
The moment she saw the skull, she subconsciously touched her face.
Without him, this fox skull is completely white, and the wisps of paint around the eyes are dense and complex, but they are exactly the direction of the veins in the Qianling Illusion Face.
It was unmistakable. In order to repair the Thousand Spirits Illusion, Wu Weiyang studied its veins hundreds of thousands of times.
She quickly walked to the stall, picked up the fox skull, and observed it repeatedly.
"Messenger, this is the skull of a fox." Huo Ya came over to take a look, and then glanced at the stall owner, "Hey, how can you, a little sparrow, have the skull of a fox?"
In the realm of monsters, foxes are closely tied to the royal family.
Huo Ya was afraid that this fox skull would make Wu Weiyang angry, and then anger Xilu.
The little sparrow was startled by the two of them. After chirping a few times, Huo Ya relaxed a little and said, "Messenger, since it was just picking it up, please spare it."
"I don't know how a little sparrow can fly to the central continent."
